hooks.command: powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$repo = try { (& git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>$null).Trim() } catch { (Get-Location).Path }; if (Test-Path (Join-Path $repo '.agent/memory.db')) { & (Join-Path $repo 'memgraph/memgraph.ps1') session-context } else { Write-Output \"memgraph: no .agent/memory.db in $repo - skill idle\" }"
